brief:
The Palestinian Petroleum Authority in Gaza announced today that no cooking gas has entered the territory, with all trucks returning from the border crossing empty, Shehab Wire reported. The authority did not specify the cause of the blockade or provide details on its duration or anticipated resolution.

The announcement comes as Israel maintains its siege of Gaza, according to the authority's statement.
